dataset: AI interoperability and AI-governance instruments relevant to a neutral cross-ecosystem bridge layer
source_note: Every row is traceable to a numbered reference or a named section of the white paper. No entry is asserted beyond what the source states. 'source_ref' points to that location.

fields.id: Stable identifier used in issues and corrections
fields.name: Name of the instrument in its original language or English
fields.issuer: Body that issued or adopted the instrument
fields.jurisdiction: quoc-te | Trung Quoc | EU | ASEAN | Viet Nam | song-phuong | khuc-vuc
fields.year: Year of issuance, or null when the source does not state one
fields.domain: interoperability | governance | policy | cooperation | trade | data
fields.status: Status as described in the source
fields.scope: What the instrument covers, in the source's own terms
fields.relevance_to_nan: Why the instrument matters for a neutral cross-ecosystem bridge layer
fields.source_ref: Where in the white paper this row comes from
